email.body1:
Von, saw Smith Micro launched SafePath OS for the senior market and guided to 24 percent sequential growth in Q2.

A new product line and a growth target usually mean more in-market carrier and partner accounts than the team can personally cover, and that is where pipeline leaks before a rep reaches out. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Smith Micro off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Von, quick follow-up for Smith Micro.

With SafePath OS expanding the addressable base, the question is usually how many meetings the team needs to convert that growth into the Q2 number. Most teams find out late, and by then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Smith Micro needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Von, last bit of proof for Smith Micro.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Smith Micro's reply rate likely compares to similar software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Von, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Around a new launch and a growth target, timing is everything, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Smith Micro either way.
